== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|An [[Archlord]] [[binding]], also known as an [[Archlord]] [[Enforcer binding]], refers to powerful spiritual techniques or properties embedded within weapons, [[constructs]], or even a person's body. These [[binding|bindings]] are characteristic of the [[Archlord]] stage of [[advancement]] and represent immense power that can be difficult for those at lower stages, such as [[Underlord|Underlords]], to utilize. Attempting to activate an [[Archlord]] [[binding]] without sufficient [[madra]] can be dangerous, potentially damaging a user's [[madra channels]] or proving unstable because the [[technique]] draws power directly from the object itself. Bindings can manifest in various forms, including [[Enforcer techniques]] that provide protection or specialized attacks. For example, a [[Forger binding]] can create transparent barriers, while other [[binding|bindings]] might manifest as physical [[constructs]] like clawed hands or spiritual domes. Some [[binding|bindings]] are integrated into a person's physiology, such as those in an arm that can be modified or strengthened over time. While some weapons are crafted without such [[binding|bindings]] to allow for easier use by lower-level practitioners, many high-level sacred instruments rely on these [[binding|bindings]] to function at their full potential.}}
